g.title: ADS1115_Leg_Board
g.text: ADDR bridged to GND (0x48). PGA Gain = 1 (+/-4.096V, 860 SPS).

g.title: PCA9685_Leg_Block
g.text: 4th slot in each 4-channel block (CH3, CH7, CH11) remains free for front/aux servos

g.title: Onboard_RC_Pullup
g.text: 4x 100nF 50V MLCC (A0..A3 to GND, fc ~ 636 Hz) + 1x 10kOhm Pull-Up (A3 to VDD_3V3)
